email.body1:
Stephen, saw Trackforce acquired TrackTik and is now combining two security workforce platforms across tens of thousands of sites.

Post-merger, buying signals usually pile up faster than the team can act on them, and the latency from signal to outreach is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up the moment a signal fires, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Trackforce off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stephen, quick follow-up for Trackforce.

Merging two customer bases usually means more in-market signals than RevOps can route in time, so the lift never shows up cleanly in the numbers. Most teams cannot measure how much pipeline that latency costs them.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly where Trackforce's signal-to-action gap is costing meetings this quarter, and how to close it without adding reps.
email.body3:
Stephen, last bit of proof for Trackforce.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trackforce's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stephen, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and integrating TrackTik keeps RevOps plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to Trackforce either way.
